jobs.title: Get a Demo
jobs.description: Get a Demo | Lema - Agentic Risk Engineer for TPRM Get a Demo Get a live demo Agentic TPRM That Finds Real Risks No compliance theater. Just a 30-minute deep dive into how to risk engineer your TPRM process. Assess in < 5 Mins Go from hours of manual analysis to instant clarity. Hunt the hidden risks Stop relying on checklists. Lema’s AI finds the deep risks that everything else misses. Map Your Blast Radius See exactly where vendors touch your critical data and catch "scope drift" before it becomes a breach. Customize to your program No rigid workflows, no forced methodology. Trusted by: TURNING TPRM TEAMS INTO RISK ENGINEERS SINCE 2024 They ditched the checklist. Here’s what happened. “Most TPRM tools are just random number generators. They make assumptions based on superficial scans that don't reflect real-world exposure. Lema is the first platform we've seen that provides a holistic, multi-dimensional view of our actual third-party risk and gives us the actionable intelligence to mitigate it” Iain Paterson CISO at Well Health “Lema has helped OPENLANE increase velocity of external vendor reviews while reducing the time to vet new vendors, more than doubling the number of vendors we are able to actively monitor.” Leon Ravenna CISO at OPENLANE “Why not just hire more analysts?' Lema catches critical risks that human teams, no matter how large the team, will always spend weeks finding if they find them at all. That isn't just efficiency; that is real security.” Pieter VanIperen CISO at AlphaSense “Traditional TPRM is a weird circus where everyone knows they're wasting each other's time with spreadsheets and checklists. It provides next to zero value. Lema is the first solution that provides true assurance by actually validating the claims vendors make, not just taking an Excel sheet for granted.” Robert Kugler Head of Security, IT & compliance at Cresta “The 250-question checklist is a significant waste of human capital. LEMA ended this unproductive theater by eliminating redundant questions and focusing on hunting for proof instead. It's the only way we can scale our operations without becoming a bottleneck. LEMA has matured our program almost overnight.” Douglas White Information Security Manager at Delta Dental

Lema is already revenue-generating with dozens of enterprise customers including fortune 500 companies. The Opportunity We are seeking an elite, high-velocity Account Executive to join our founding sales team. Reporting directly to the VP of Sales, you will focus on hunting and closing mid-market (1K-10K employee) and enterprise (10K+) accounts. This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a perfect system. You will be actively contributing to our broader go-to-market efforts-from iterating on the playbook and shaping ROI business cases to generating new sales collateral. What You'll Do Hunt and Close: Own the full sales cycle from proactive pipeline generation to six-figure deal closure. Run the POC Motion: Drive technical wins by understanding core cybersecurity concepts, managing technical stakeholders, and executing tight 30-90 day Proof of Concepts. Map Complex Orgs: Navigate enterprise accounts, identify key decision-makers (CISOs, CIOs, Head of Risk), and build consensus across multiple influencers. Build the Engine: Act as a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity; create your own outreach strategies, target lists, and sales collateral. Qualify Ruthlessly: Use discovery to uncover true pain points and exercise sharp judgment on when to push forward, pivot, or disqualify an opportunity. Requirements What You Bring 6+ years of total B2B sales experience , with at least 4+ years specifically as an AE selling B2B mid-market or enterprise cybersecurity. Post-Series A cybersecurity startup experience. You know what it takes to build the plane while flying it. A proven track record of sourcing your own pipeline and hitting quota without relying entirely on inbound marketing. A robust customer and partner network, that will act as a spring board for success. Strong technical aptitude to hold credibility—the "challenger" approach—with highly technical security buyers. Scrappy & Resourceful: You make a big impact with lean resources and have the hustle to try different channels until you get traction. Tactful Operator: You are highly skilled in navigating sensitive stakeholder discussions and complex negotiations. Smart & Intuitive: You are quick on your feet, can grasp technical nuances, and instantly adapt your messaging to the room. We analyze every vendor like a vulnerability researcher would: how could an attacker use this vendor to get in, and what could they reach?
